title: The Lost Dog
lines: Omar got a dollar from his gran.
He ran to the shop by the barn.
A dog ran in with a red collar.
Omar took it to the vet by the shop.
The vet read the tag on the collar.
A sailor came in. "That is my dog!"
He gave Omar a dollar for his help.

questions.listenFor: The tag on the dog's collar. It is in the fifth line.

questions.ask: Who did the dog belong to?
questions.listenFor: The sailor. Note how the -or on the end says er.

questions.ask: Will Omar keep the dollar or spend it? Why?
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. You want a reason, not a right choice.
